scope: Bounded source/component/contract fixtures and independent planning JSON validation; no GUI/build/deploy/full typecheck claim.

dependencies.necessarilySequentialWholeTaskList: Not defined: producer-output phase gates, not exclusive whole-task scheduling.

mappingAssumptions.direct: UI: actualAcceptanceOutputs+uiIntegrationOutputs only. SVC/INT: hardAcceptanceDependencyIds resolved to service groups. Platform/QA/release/recheck: hardAcceptanceDependencies inherited from owning package. Deduplicate by leaf ID.
mappingAssumptions.full: Add uniform UI immutableReleaseBinding and per-target realExecutionOutput bindings. Count each UI leaf once; do not count948 target activities as extra tasks.
mappingAssumptions.noDeclaredInputs: Absence in allocation is not absence of intrinsic internal sequencing, functional requirements, runtime environments or resource limits. Source plan cannot establish current output/resource availability.
mappingAssumptions.cycles: Consumer and producer task-level phase gates can form apparent cycles, such as native stage -> installer -> installed native verification. Validating a global whole-task acyclic schedule would be incorrect. MacOS explicit phase-node graph is checked separately.
